name: Are my files uploaded when adding page numbers?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Page numbering is processed entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Files never leave your device. You can verify this: open DevTools → Network tab — you should not see your PDF being uploaded during processing.

name: Does PDFree store or log my files after processing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree runs entirely in your browser — there is no backend server that receives your files. Because nothing is uploaded, nothing can be stored, logged, or retained. Your document exists only in your browser's memory for the duration of the session and is cleared when you close the tab.

name: Can I start page numbering from a number other than 1?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Set any starting number in the 'Start at' field. This is useful for documents where a cover page is page 0, or for chapters that continue numbering from a previous section.

name: Can I skip the first page (cover page) when numbering?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Enable the 'Skip first page' option. Page 1 (the cover) receives no number, and numbering starts from the second page.

name: Can I choose where page numbers appear?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Position options include bottom center, bottom left, bottom right, top center, top left, and top right.

name: Is there a page limit for adding page numbers?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree has no page or file size limits. The only practical constraint is your device's available memory.

name: What does it mean to paginate a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paginating a PDF means adding visible page numbers to each page of the document. Pagination makes long documents easier to navigate, reference, and print. PDFree paginates PDFs online free — choose the number format, position, and starting number, then download the paginated PDF instantly.

name: Is the PDF page numbering tool free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree is completely free — no subscription, no sign up, no watermarks on the output. There are no limits on file size or number of pages.

name: Will adding page numbers change the existing content?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Page numbers are added as a new text layer on top of the existing content. The original text, images, and layout underneath are unchanged.

name: Can I add page numbers to a scanned PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Scanned PDFs are treated identically to any other PDF — the page number is overlaid on each page as a text element. The underlying scan image is not changed.

name: Can I add page numbers to multiple PDF files at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Select or drag in multiple PDF files and PDFree numbers the pages of each one using your chosen format and position, entirely in your browser. The numbered files are bundled into a single ZIP for download — no upload, no daily limit.
